questions.stem: CLZ-360 apply succeeds, but Heartbeat has no rows. What is the expected explanation?

options.A: No data source or collection rule is attached by this lesson
options.B: Succeeded guarantees a VM heartbeat every minute
options.C: The action group writes heartbeat rows
options.D: Terraform must be rerun until rows appear

optionExplanations.A: The lesson provisions a foundation without a telemetry source.
optionExplanations.B: Resource provisioning is not agent data ingestion.
optionExplanations.C: Action groups deliver actions, not VM heartbeat records.
optionExplanations.D: Repeating apply does not add an absent source.

questions.stem: Which boundary does the deployed Log Analytics workspace provide?

options.A: An HTTP load-balancer frontend
options.C: A store and query scope for collected log data
options.D: A Windows VM image

optionExplanations.A: Load balancing is a different service.
optionExplanations.B: Traffic Manager handles DNS routing.
optionExplanations.C: The workspace defines where logs are stored and queried.
optionExplanations.D: A workspace is not a VM image.

questions.stem: What is the role of the operations action group in CLZ-360?

options.A: A rule deciding whether CPU is too high
options.C: An autoscale rule
options.D: A reusable target for configured alert actions and notifications

optionExplanations.A: An alert rule evaluates the condition.
optionExplanations.B: An agent sends telemetry.
optionExplanations.C: Autoscaling is not created here.
optionExplanations.D: It provides action configuration for alerts.

questions.stem: The action group exists, but nobody receives an alert. What capability is missing from this lesson as written?

options.A: A new random VM suffix
options.B: An alert rule connected to appropriate receivers
options.C: A larger resource-group tag
options.D: A shorter workspace name

optionExplanations.A: Naming does not create an alert.
optionExplanations.B: No rule or receiver is configured to send a meaningful alert.
optionExplanations.C: Tags do not supply notification routing.
optionExplanations.D: Name length is not a delivery rule.

questions.stem: Which log retention value is configured in the Terraform workspace resource?

options.A: 7 hours
options.C: Unlimited lifetime
options.D: One Terraform plan

optionExplanations.A: The unit is days and the configured value is 30.
optionExplanations.B: retention_in_days is explicitly 30.
optionExplanations.C: No indefinite retention is configured.
optionExplanations.D: Plan lifetime is not log retention.

questions.stem: A production workload begins sending large volumes to the workspace. What cost driver needs reassessment?

options.A: The number of PowerShell comments
options.C: The lesson navigation order
options.D: Data ingestion and retention

optionExplanations.A: Comments do not ingest Azure data.
optionExplanations.B: Illustrations do not change workspace ingestion.
optionExplanations.C: Page ordering is unrelated to billing.
optionExplanations.D: Collected data volume and retention influence Monitor cost.

questions.stem: A query returns an authorization error rather than no rows. What should be verified?

options.A: Only whether the table would be empty
options.C: Workspace query permissions and selected tenant
options.D: Only the retention period

optionExplanations.A: No-data expectations do not explain denied authorization.
optionExplanations.B: Quiz results cannot grant Azure permissions.
optionExplanations.C: Access failures require identity and scope diagnosis.
optionExplanations.D: Retention does not grant query rights.

questions.stem: What does Heartbeat | take 5 request?

options.A: Up to five records from the Heartbeat table
options.C: Keep all logs for five days
options.D: Send five emails through the action group

optionExplanations.A: It queries existing rows and limits the returned set.
optionExplanations.B: KQL does not deploy agents.
optionExplanations.C: take is not retention configuration.
optionExplanations.D: It is not an alert-delivery command.

questions.stem: Which KQL expression counts existing Heartbeat records by computer?

options.A: Heartbeat | take Computer
options.C: Heartbeat | retention 30
options.D: Heartbeat | summarize count() by Computer

optionExplanations.A: take expects a row limit, not this grouping operation.
optionExplanations.B: KQL queries do not create VMs.
optionExplanations.C: That is not a retention-setting statement.
optionExplanations.D: summarize groups and aggregates rows by Computer.

questions.stem: What production addition describes which guest data an agent collects and where it sends it?

options.A: A Traffic Manager endpoint priority
options.C: A Key Vault purge permission
options.D: A public registrar delegation

optionExplanations.A: Routing priorities do not select guest logs.
optionExplanations.B: A DCR defines a collection and destination configuration.
optionExplanations.C: Purge permissions do not collect telemetry.
optionExplanations.D: Public DNS delegation does not configure monitoring.

questions.stem: A service's platform logs are not reaching the workspace. What should a production design review?

options.A: The service's diagnostic settings and supported destinations
options.C: The Terraform filename casing alone
options.D: The companion book cover

optionExplanations.A: Platform log routing needs appropriate diagnostic configuration.
optionExplanations.B: Theme does not route telemetry.
optionExplanations.C: Filename case alone does not attach a source.
optionExplanations.D: Artwork is unrelated to ingestion.

questions.stem: Which proposal best fits the alert design exercise?

options.A: A notification with no signal or owner
options.B: A workspace created without a data source
options.C: A defined signal, threshold, evaluation window, owner, and runbook
options.D: A screenshot showing only resource tags

optionExplanations.A: Unowned undiagnosable notifications are ineffective.
optionExplanations.B: Provisioning alone is not alert logic.
optionExplanations.C: The exercise calls for an actionable condition and response.
optionExplanations.D: Tags are not the required alert definition.

questions.stem: Before production notification testing, what should be confirmed?

options.A: That every tenant user is subscribed automatically
options.B: That Terraform init sends a test email
options.C: Receiver configuration and the intended nonproduction recipients
options.D: That a workspace name equals an email address

optionExplanations.A: There is no tenant-wide default recipient.
optionExplanations.B: Initialization is not a notification test.
optionExplanations.C: Receivers require explicit configuration and intentional testing.
optionExplanations.D: Names do not create email receivers.

questions.stem: Which lesson query reports workspace provisioning and retention?

options.A: az monitor log-analytics workspace show
options.C: terraform apply tfplan
options.D: terraform destroy

optionExplanations.A: The show query reads workspace metadata.
optionExplanations.B: Create mutates an action group.
optionExplanations.C: Apply changes resources.
optionExplanations.D: Destroy removes resources.

questions.stem: Which component should evaluate an alert's condition on a signal?

options.A: The action group's short_name
options.C: A resource-group tag
options.D: The browser progress store

optionExplanations.A: The short name is notification metadata.
optionExplanations.B: Rules evaluate conditions and trigger configured actions.
optionExplanations.C: Tags do not evaluate signals.
optionExplanations.D: Local progress has no Azure alert role.

questions.stem: A daily ingestion cap is proposed for production. What implication must be understood?

options.A: It guarantees every event is collected indefinitely
options.C: It makes all alert actions free
options.D: It can control volume while leaving a telemetry gap after the cap is reached

optionExplanations.A: A cap cannot promise unlimited collection.
optionExplanations.B: Identity permissions remain enforced.
optionExplanations.C: Receiver services can have their own costs.
optionExplanations.D: A cost limit has an observability tradeoff.

questions.stem: Which claim about CLZ-360 is inaccurate?

options.A: It installs Azure Monitor Agent on an IIS VM
options.C: It creates an action group
options.D: It provides an operations resource group

optionExplanations.A: No VM or guest agent is configured by this lesson.
optionExplanations.B: The workspace resource is present.
optionExplanations.C: The action-group resource is present.
optionExplanations.D: The resource group is part of the configuration.

questions.stem: Heartbeat exists in another workspace but not in the selected one. What should be checked?

options.A: Whether every action group has the same name
options.B: Whether the log file is a GitHub image
options.C: Whether DNS TTL is 60
options.D: The queried workspace and the data collection destination

optionExplanations.A: Action-group names do not move records.
optionExplanations.B: GitHub artwork is unrelated.
optionExplanations.C: DNS TTL does not route log ingestion.
optionExplanations.D: Logs are stored in their configured destination workspace.

questions.stem: Why should this lesson's Low classification still include budget review?

options.A: The class guarantees an exact zero invoice
options.B: Every action group requires a Bastion VM
options.C: Future ingestion, retention, and receiver usage can add costs
options.D: Terraform charges by code line

optionExplanations.A: The class is not a billing guarantee.
optionExplanations.B: No Bastion dependency is configured.
optionExplanations.C: Classification is relative, not a fixed price promise.
optionExplanations.D: Code line counts are not service meters.

questions.stem: Which production practice restricts who can query operational logs?

options.A: Publish the workspace's full credentials in README
options.B: Assign appropriate workspace or resource-context access permissions
options.C: Assume its region makes it private to one user
options.D: Remove all alert rules

optionExplanations.A: Publication leaks sensitive access material.
optionExplanations.B: Access control should match readers and operational scopes.
optionExplanations.C: Region is not user authorization.
optionExplanations.D: Removing alerts does not scope query rights.

questions.stem: A team wants an IIS outage alert. Which design is more meaningful than workspace existence?

options.A: Alert every time Terraform files are listed
options.B: Treat workspace Succeeded as eternal IIS health
options.C: Use only the action group name as the signal
options.D: A representative service signal with a failure threshold and response

optionExplanations.A: File listing does not test IIS availability.
optionExplanations.B: Provisioning does not prove workload health.
optionExplanations.C: Names are not telemetry conditions.
optionExplanations.D: Availability monitoring must observe the application path.

questions.stem: Why include deduplication and maintenance controls in an alert delivery design?

options.A: Guarantee incidents cannot occur
options.C: Reduce repeated noise and handle planned work without losing incident ownership
options.D: Remove every receiver

optionExplanations.A: They cannot prevent all failures.
optionExplanations.B: Delivery controls are not log erasure.
optionExplanations.C: Operational controls improve signal handling.
optionExplanations.D: Removing all receivers defeats notification.

questions.stem: What active resources does CLZ-360 cleanup remove?

options.A: All workspaces in the tenant
options.B: Its workspace, action group, and resource group
options.C: Any external VM that sent a heartbeat
options.D: Every production alert rule regardless of ownership

optionExplanations.A: Tenant-wide removal is outside scope.
optionExplanations.B: Destroy acts on resources owned by this lesson.
optionExplanations.C: Telemetry sources are not implicitly owned.
optionExplanations.D: Unrelated rules are outside this state.

questions.stem: A learner wants to immediately reuse a deleted workspace name. What should be considered?

options.A: Workspace soft-delete and recovery behavior
options.C: Whether its action group is purple
options.D: The PDF's license text

optionExplanations.A: Service recovery behavior can affect deletion and reuse.
optionExplanations.B: Variable count does not determine recovery.
optionExplanations.C: Artwork has no deletion semantics.
optionExplanations.D: Book licensing is unrelated.

questions.stem: Which exercise can be completed by writing a query before any source is attached?

options.A: Prove a real VM sent a heartbeat without deploying or using one
options.B: Draft a Heartbeat summary grouped by Computer
options.C: Claim live ingestion solely from an SVG
options.D: Send production alerts to arbitrary recipients

optionExplanations.A: Evidence requires an actual configured source.
optionExplanations.B: The lesson permits query design before data exists.
optionExplanations.C: A diagram is not telemetry evidence.
optionExplanations.D: Recipients require intentional configuration.

questions.stem: Which evidence supports an empty-foundation outcome without inventing data?

options.A: Workspace metadata, the actual query outcome, and an explicit no-source explanation
options.B: A fabricated heartbeat row marked live
options.C: An unrelated VM screenshot presented as this lesson
options.D: Only a success claim with no query context

optionExplanations.A: Record the real result, including an empty or unavailable table when no source has created telemetry.
optionExplanations.B: Fabrication is not validation.
optionExplanations.C: Unrelated evidence does not establish this configuration's data.
optionExplanations.D: Context is needed to interpret empty results.

questions.stem: Two alert rules should notify the same operations destination. What pattern fits?

options.A: Duplicate the Log Analytics workspace for every email
options.B: Rename every VM to the email address
options.C: Give the action group a SQL password
options.D: Associate both with the same appropriately configured action group

optionExplanations.A: Workspace duplication is not required for shared actions.
optionExplanations.B: VM names do not configure notifications.
optionExplanations.C: SQL credentials are unrelated.
optionExplanations.D: Action groups can serve multiple alert rules.

questions.stem: A colleague suggests recreating the empty workspace to get Heartbeat rows. What should be checked instead?

options.A: Whether the workspace name is shorter than five characters
options.B: Whether the dark theme is selected
options.C: Whether a real source, agent, and collection configuration exist
options.D: Whether source files use CRLF

optionExplanations.A: Name length does not create a heartbeat source.
optionExplanations.B: Theme is unrelated to Azure ingestion.
optionExplanations.C: Recreation does not add absent telemetry collection.
optionExplanations.D: Line endings do not create data sources.

questions.stem: Which production addition connects an alert to a responsible response?

options.A: A new illustrated card alone
options.C: A larger README title
options.D: Defined severity, incident owner, and runbook

optionExplanations.A: Artwork does not assign operational responsibility.
optionExplanations.B: Names do not resolve incident ownership.
optionExplanations.C: Heading size does not define response.
optionExplanations.D: Alerts need a response process, not just a resource.

questions.stem: Browser-local lesson progress says Complete. What does it prove about CLZ-360 telemetry?

options.A: Only the learner-reported progress, not live Azure ingestion
options.C: That notification delivery was tested
options.D: That all workspace logs were preserved

optionExplanations.A: Local progress is not live Azure evidence.
optionExplanations.B: No browser field proves agent reporting.
optionExplanations.C: Delivery needs independent testing.
optionExplanations.D: Retention requires Azure data and configuration evidence.
